headline: Modular Unifies AI Development Through Mojo and MAX
lede: The Modular platform bridges the gap between hardware-agnostic performance and Python-based productivity. It provides a specialized compiler and inference engine designed for high-throughput AI infrastructure.

headline: Modular Skills Inject Engineering Discipline Into Coding Agents
lede: These lightweight, composable workflows enforce Test-Driven Development and architectural standards during AI-led coding tasks. By moving beyond ad-hoc generation, agents become reliable partners in complex software design.

headline: OpenLogi Offers Local-First Hardware Control Without Telemetry
lede: This Rust-based tool provides a transparent, account-free alternative to proprietary Logitech peripheral management. It enables deep hardware configuration through an efficient, privacy-conscious interface.

headline: Superpowers Framework Standardizes Agentic Development Processes
lede: Superpowers enforces a rigorous methodology for AI assistants, including mandatory task decomposition and structured code reviews. It ensures that autonomous agents maintain context and follow strict engineering principles throughout the development lifecycle.

headline: Cursor Plugins Create a Modular Ecosystem for AI-Driven IDEs
lede: The official Cursor plugin hub enables complex agentic interactions directly within the development environment. By standardizing plugin manifests, it transforms the code editor into a central control plane for enterprise productivity.

headline: Career-Ops Automates Systematic Job Search Workflows
lede: This AI-powered tool creates a command-line pipeline for evaluating job opportunities and managing application lifecycles. It shifts the burden of tedious search tasks to autonomous agents while maintaining human oversight.

headline: AI-Memory Bridges Context Gaps Between Different Coding Agents
lede: This middleware solution captures lifecycle observations to provide persistent, shared knowledge across various AI coding assistants. It eliminates vendor lock-in by maintaining a unified ledger of architectural decisions.

headline: MoneyPrinterTurbo Simplifies Automated Short-Form Video Production
lede: This project integrates multiple large language models and TTS engines to produce high-quality video content from minimal text inputs. Its plugin-based architecture allows for rapid, scalable automation of social media workflows.

headline: Agent Substrate Optimizes High-Density Agent Deployments on Kubernetes
lede: Agent Substrate manages stateful actor lifecycles to reduce resource overhead in massive agent swarms. By utilizing microVMs, it allows for efficient suspension and resumption of agents on limited compute infrastructure.

headline: Munder Difflin Orchestrates AI Agents in a Virtual Workspace
lede: This visual harness creates a self-coordinating team of coding agents managed by a central orchestration engine. It transforms isolated CLI tools into an intuitive environment for complex, collaborative software development.
